content_zh:
第一章死后的穿越新人写书，请多多支持！求下收藏，点击！
“啊~睡的真舒服啊，有多久没有睡过这么饱的觉了！~都十点了啊”陈林伸了个懒腰看了下表都已经十点了。
陈林今年23岁175cm的个头不是很高，唯一让他满意的就是自己的长相还算帅自我感觉超级良好！有自恋的嫌疑！
本科文凭没读完，现在是一个保健品推销员说白了就是卖那啥药的~，因为没考上好的专业，感觉钱途很渺茫，还没毕业陈林就去找工作。但是因为没文凭没特长，只能成为一名‘光荣’的保健品推销员，凭借着在大学里追女生时，练就的死缠烂打神功和七嘴八舌神功，厚着脸皮倒也能赚钱养活自己，这不由于业绩突出公司决定给他升职发了奖金，还有就是破天荒的给他放了三天的带薪假工作了一年半了第一次啊~。
俗话说人逢喜事精神爽，陈林感觉今天的天气都清爽了许多。草草的吃过早饭后，陈林决定今天出去好好玩玩。
“就去城西郊区的那座小山去爬山去吧！那可是美女最愿意去的景区之一”心里这么想着，陈林就在家里出发了。
刚坐上了去城西郊区的车就看到一车全是年青的男女！陈林在上车后就向后走去！
“不是吧，这么幸运”陈林在后面找坐位的时候，正好看到了一个美女自己坐在一个两人坐上。
大大的眼睛、小巧的琼鼻、精致的嘴唇而且笑起来还有两个小酒窝，身材虽然不是是前凸后翘但是非常匀称，长长的头发用一根简单的蓝色头绳扎了起来，穿着一件很普通的白色的t恤配了一条瘦腿的蓝色牛仔裤。整体看起来那叫一个清纯啊！
在短暂的呆滞后，陈林反应过来并给了对方一个帅气的笑容！果断走了过去直接坐在她的身边！
坐下后陈林就开始搭讪起来，经过了一番闲聊后陈林知道了，她是个大学生，叫做张慧，是个大三的学生，刚修完学科出来玩玩。
在车上没一会功夫，陈林已经和张慧渐渐的熟络起来，而且陈林也厚颜无耻的直接叫她小慧！
很快汽车就到了城西郊区的小山下，“小慧，要不我们一起爬吧，这地方我熟啊，大学的时候我每周都过来的~！”陈林一看到站了，就赶紧做出了邀请。
“是吗，听说这是有名的情侣山，看来你经常带女生过来啊！”陈林没想到小慧竟然调侃起自己来了。
陈林一时语塞，于是干笑道“呵呵，哪有啊！我哪有那么好的命单独约到女生啊……”
小慧的调侃让陈林一时有点尴尬，不过陈林很快又开始风趣的跟小慧说笑起来。一路陈林使出了浑身的解数，逗得小慧笑个不停，就这么说说笑笑他们来到了半山腰上。
“渴了吗，你等着我去给你买点水去啊”看这小慧嘴唇有点干，陈林马上就开始献起了殷勤，不等小慧回绝就买水去了。
可就在陈林买水回来的时候，发现竟然有个三十上下的男人在和小慧聊天。“靠，不会被挖我墙角了吧！”陈林用最快的速度跑了回来。
“吓了我一跳，原来是个算命的啊。我说怎么穿的这么土啊~”赶到后陈林才发现只是个算命先生！这个人长相很平凡是那种转眼就会忘的角色，不过总是给人一中很亲切的感觉。身上穿着很朴素的唐装，看起来倒也有几分世外高人的感觉。
不过陈林还是故意打岔道“小慧，水~！别信这个都是骗人的，我们走吧！”

“没有啊，他说的很准啊”不知道这个算命的给小慧说了些什么，竟然让这个小丫头这么相信！
而就在这时候这个算命先生也注意到了陈林，双眼向着陈林身上看了看，微微叹息道“这位小哥，我看你脸色红润放光，必是刚遇喜事有逢桃花啊~呵呵”说着他又看了看小慧，小慧很配合的害羞的低下了头。
“这个谁看不出来啊！走了小慧，我们山后面那里有很多很好玩的地方你肯定没去过~~”陈林对这个算命的没什么好感，于是就叫上小慧继续爬山。
“小哥莫着急，且听我把话说完”算命先生却伸手拦住了陈林和小慧，接着说道，“虽你面色放光但是眉宇之间有黑气阴霾不散！脸色红润却又有散不去的晦气隐在底下！看来你近日必有大劫啊！恐怕是性命难保啊……”
说完后陈林纲要发火，却见他从包里掏出了一个叠成三角形的黄符递向他“你我相见就是缘，这道符你随身带着，虽说不定能帮你渡过劫难，但却能给你增加点福缘！”
见陈林不收他接着说道“放心我是不收钱的~~！”说完直接塞到了陈林的手中，他便头也不回的走了。
“这个人真是莫名其妙”说着陈林就要把道符给丢掉！
小慧却阻止了陈林说道“别，就当是个护身符带着呗！图个吉利”说完帮陈林放到了上衣口袋里，并帮陈林轻轻抚平！
陈林被小慧的这个十分暧昧动作，弄的心跳猛然加速心想“算了，既然小慧都这么说了，我也就勉为其难的装着吧”
于是他们继续爬山游玩，很快来到了山顶，这座山他们都经常来，所以正面和山顶都没什么好看的了。倒是山后面有几处山洞因为都是小路所以很少有人去。
于是陈林开始怂恿道“小慧，听说山后面有很多的山洞很好玩，你没去过吧，我带你去看看！”
“是吗！我还是第一次听说这座山还有山洞呢！”小慧听后很感兴趣，不过接着又担心道“山后面安全吗？不会有野兽什么的吧！”
“放心，那里哪有什么野兽啊，我都去过好几次了！那里特好玩……”陈林接着诱惑着。

Chapter 1: Newcomers writing books about time travel after death, please support me! Please click to collect it!
"Ah~ I slept so comfortably. It's been a long time since I had such a full sleep!~ It's already ten o'clock." Chen Lin stretched and looked at the watch. It was already ten o'clock.
Chen Lin is 23 years old this year and is not very tall at 175cm. The only thing that satisfies him is that he looks pretty handsome and feels very good about himself! There is suspicion of narcissism!
I didn't finish my undergraduate degree, and now I'm a health care product salesman. To put it bluntly, I just sell medicine. Because I didn't get into a good major, I felt that my money prospects were very slim. Before I graduated, Chen Lin went to find a job. But because he has no diploma and no special skills, he can only become a "glorious" health care product salesman. With the magic skills of stalking and gossiping that he developed while chasing girls in college, he can make money to support himself even though he is shameless. Not only because of his outstanding performance, the company decided to give him a promotion and a bonus, but also because he was given an unprecedented three days of paid leave for the first time after working for a year and a half.
As the saying goes, people feel refreshed during happy events. Chen Lin felt that the weather today was much refreshing. After a hasty breakfast, Chen Lin decided to go out and have some fun today.
"Let's go hiking on that hill in the western suburbs of the city! That's one of the most popular scenic spots for beauties." With this thought in his mind, Chen Lin set off at home.
As soon as I got on the bus to the western suburbs of the city, I saw a bus full of young men and women! Chen Lin walked back after getting in the car!
"No, you're so lucky." When Chen Lin was looking for a seat at the back, he happened to see a beautiful woman sitting on a two-person seat.
He has big eyes, a small nose, delicate lips, and two small dimples when he smiles. Although his figure is not convex and backward, he is very well-proportioned. His long hair is tied up with a simple blue headband, and he is wearing a very ordinary white T-shirt and a pair of slim-legged blue jeans. The overall look is pure!
After a brief moment of sluggishness, Chen Lin reacted and gave the other party a handsome smile! He decisively walked over and sat directly next to her!
After sitting down, Chen Lin started to strike up a conversation. After some chatting, Chen Lin found out that she was a college student named Zhang Hui. She was a junior student and had just finished her studies and came out to have fun.
After a while in the car, Chen Lin gradually became familiar with Zhang Hui, and Chen Lin shamelessly called her Xiaohui!
Soon the car arrived at the foot of the hill in the western suburbs of the city. "Xiaohui, why don't we climb together? I'm familiar with this place. I came here every week when I was in college~!" As soon as Chen Lin saw the stop, he quickly made an invitation.
"Really? I heard that this is a famous couple's mountain. It seems that you often bring girls here!" Chen Lin didn't expect that Xiaohui would actually tease him.
Chen Lin was speechless for a moment, so he laughed dryly and said, "Haha, no way! How can I have such good luck to date a girl alone..."
Xiaohui's teasing made Chen Lin feel a little embarrassed for a while, but Chen Lin soon started joking with Xiaohui in a funny way. Along the way, Chen Lin tried his best to make Xiaohui laugh non-stop. Just talking and laughing, they reached the mountainside.
"Are you thirsty? Wait for me to buy you some water." Seeing that Xiaohui's lips were a little dry, Chen Lin immediately began to be attentive and bought water without waiting for Xiaohui's refusal.
But when Chen Lin came back from buying water, he found a man in his thirties chatting with Xiaohui. "Damn, I won't be poached!" Chen Lin ran back as fast as he could.
"I was shocked. It turned out to be a fortune teller. I thought, why are you dressed so crudely?" After arriving, Chen Lin discovered that he was just a fortune teller! This person looks very ordinary, the kind of character who is easily forgotten in a blink of an eye, but he always gives people a very friendly feeling. Wearing a very simple Tang suit, he looks a bit like an outsider.However, Chen Lin deliberately interrupted and said, "Xiaohui, Shui~! Don't believe this is all a lie, let's go!"
"No, what he said is very accurate." I don't know what this fortune teller said to Xiao Hui to make this little girl believe it so much!
At this time, the fortune teller also noticed Chen Lin, looked at Chen Lin, and sighed slightly, "Brother, I see your face is rosy and shining, you must have just met a happy event~ Haha." As he said that, he looked at Xiaohui again, and Xiaohui lowered her head shyly in cooperation.
"Who can't see this! Come on, Xiaohui, there are many interesting places behind our mountain that you must have never been to~~" Chen Lin didn't like this fortune teller, so he asked Xiaohui to continue climbing the mountain.
"Brother, don't be anxious, please listen to what I have to say." The fortune teller stretched out his hand to stop Chen Lin and Xiao Hui, and continued, "Although your face is radiant, there is a dark haze between your eyebrows! Your face is rosy, but there is lingering bad luck underneath! It seems that you will have a big disaster in the near future! I'm afraid your life is hard to save..."
After saying that, Chen Lingang was about to get angry, but he saw him take out a yellow talisman folded into a triangle from his bag and hand it to him, "It is fate that we meet each other. You should carry this talisman with you. Although it may not be able to help you survive the disaster, it will give you some luck!"
Seeing that Chen Lin refused to accept the offer, he continued, "Don't worry, I won't charge you~~!" After saying that, he stuffed it directly into Chen Lin's hand and left without looking back.
"This person is really inexplicable." Chen Lin said and was about to throw away the Taoist talisman!
But Xiaohui stopped Chen Lin and said, "No, just think of it as a talisman! Just for good luck." After saying that, she helped Chen Lin put it in his jacket pocket and gently smoothed it for Chen Lin!
Chen Lin's heartbeat suddenly accelerated due to Xiaohui's very ambiguous action, and he thought, "Forget it, since Xiaohui said so, I'll just pretend to be reluctant."
So they continued to climb the mountain and soon reached the top of the mountain. They came to this mountain often, so there was nothing interesting to see from the front or the top. However, there are several caves behind the mountain that few people go to because they are all paths.
So Chen Lin began to encourage, "Xiao Hui, I heard that there are many interesting caves behind the mountain. Have you never been there? I will take you to see them!"
"Really! This is the first time I heard that there is a cave in this mountain!" Xiaohui was very interested after hearing this, but then worried, "Is it safe behind the mountain? There won't be wild animals or anything like that!"
"Don't worry, there aren't any wild beasts there. I've been there several times! It's so fun there..." Chen Lin continued to seduce.
